basic_profile.bio: I'm a 24-year-old software developer based in Bangalore, India. I have a deep passion for RPGs and games that involve grinding stats. When I'm not coding or gaming, I enjoy exploring different philosophies and engaging in discussions around spirituality and belief systems. I typically browse Reddit in the evenings after work and during weekends. Currently single, I'm focused on advancing my career and gaming skills.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in computer science, having graduated from a local university. My expertise in gaming comes from years of playing various RPGs and MMOs as a hobby. I often explore new games to understand their mechanics and love analyzing games that incorporate complex stat systems.
